title: P7: brain — инструкции модуля через каталог harness

sections.title: Инструкции модуля brain через каталог harness (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor, .grok)
sections.text:
`packages/<id>/CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor-instructions.mdc`, `.grok-instructions.md` генерируются harness из каталога инструкций; руками не пишутся (правило плана о генерируемых файлах). Источник: `packages/harness/lib/harness/instructions.py` (`TARGETS`, `COMMON_IDS`, строки ~41–100), `packages/harness/configs/common/instructions/catalog.json` (`scopes[]` с `id`, `claude_target`, `codex_target`, `sections[]`: `id`, `scope_id`, `kind: common`, `provider_id: null`, `order`, `intent`, `obligations`, `sources` с `sha256` фрагмента, `compatibility_assertions`), фрагмент `packages/harness/configs/common/instructions/packages/<id>/common.md` (блоки `<!-- instruction:<id> -->` + `## <id>` + текст), контракт `packages/harness/docs/reference/provider-instruction-contract.md` (таблица инвентаря scope), фикстуры `packages/harness/tests/fixtures_data/instruction-{compatibility,literal-coverage}-v1.json`, генератор `scripts/generate-provider-instructions.py` (golden `harness-provider-instructions`). Образец — scope `analyst` (P2.4 добавлял секцию root тем же путём).

Scope `brain`: цели `packages/brain/CLAUDE.md`, `packages/brain/AGENTS.md`, `packages/brain/.cursor-instructions.mdc`, `packages/brain/.grok-instructions.md`; секции (порядок = order 1–6; текст — дословно):
- `brain.identity` — "`brain` is the ecosystem module for the Obsidian vault: it finds the vault, syncs project documents with it and writes notes from ecosystem events; the vault belongs to a person, so brain adds notes and never rewrites their files."
- `brain.layout` — "Keep `bin/brain` as the launcher, `lib/brain/` as stdlib-only logic on `aicore`, `skills/` for the module's own skills, and temporary-directory tests with the synthetic vault in `tests/fixtures/vault`."
- `brain.module-boundaries` — "Import only `brain` and `aicore`; reach planner, maind and skiller through events and their command lines, and take the vault path from `brain vault` resolution (configuration `brain.vault_path`), never from a hardcoded path."
- `brain.vault-safety` — "Write to the vault only through `brain note` (one new note per event, idempotent by event id, never overwriting a file) and an explicit `brain docs push`; keep notes outside the synced `docs`, `docs-public` and `plans` folders."
- `brain.engineering-invariants` — "Keep Python 3.9 compatibility, English diagnostics, `BrainError` codes and the subscriber answer contract: one JSON object on stdout, exit 65 for invalid event data and 75 for temporary failures."
- `brain.validation-release` — "Before a commit run `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/validate.sh`, then `python3 scripts/ecosystem-units.py check` and `python3 scripts/ecosystem-units.py standalone brain` from the hub root; use Russian Conventional Commit messages."

Применение — как P2.4: `harness instructions plan|apply|check --target <repo>` в песочнице (`apply --authorize <цели>`); затем `python3 scripts/generate-provider-instructions.py` (без `--check`) и `python3 scripts/golden.py capture --only harness-provider-instructions,harness-instructions --reason "brain module instruction scope"` — только генераторы, чьи выходы изменились (`golden.py check` до захвата показывает какие). Бюджет первого хода корня не меняется (scope brain загружается только в `packages/brain`), проверка — `skiller budget --first-turn` в песочнице.
